title: alt registration and biometric login
rule: Alt registration (social/federated) + biometric login where the platform has it.

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Registration and Login Forms on Mobile

pass_when: Federated/social registration is offered; biometric login is offered where the platform has it.
fail_when: Platform has the capability and neither alt registration nor biometric is offered when this checklist applies.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: That every product must ship every social provider.
